rule_title: Data Encryption in Transit and at Rest
rule_text: The vendor must ensure that all customer personal data and confidential data is encrypted both in transit using TLS 1.3 (or minimum TLS 1.2 with strong cipher suites) and at rest using AES-256 or equivalent cryptographic standards.
applicability_conditions: Vendor stores, transmits, or processes sensitive personal or confidential business data.
required_action_or_control: Enforce TLS 1.2+ for all external and internal endpoints; encrypt databases, block storage, and backups with AES-256.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Evidence must be verified annually; encryption key rotation every 12 months.
exceptions: Ephemeral caches storing solely non-sensitive public metadata are exempt.

rule_title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for Administrative Access
rule_text: All vendor personnel accessing production environments, customer databases, or infrastructure management consoles must be required to authenticate via phishing-resistant Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).
applicability_conditions: Vendor personnel possess privileged or administrative access to systems hosting client data.
required_action_or_control: Enforce hardware tokens, FIDO2/WebAuthn, or authenticator app MFA for 100% of privileged user accounts.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Evidence of enforcement must be dated within the last 12 months.
exceptions: Automated service accounts utilizing certificate-based mutual TLS (mTLS) with short-lived tokens.

rule_title: Annual Third-Party Penetration Testing
rule_text: The vendor must commission an independent, certified third-party cybersecurity firm to conduct penetration testing on all customer-facing applications and infrastructure at least once every 12 months, and remediate all Critical and High severity findings within 30 days.
applicability_conditions: Vendor provides software-as-a-service or cloud hosted infrastructure.
required_action_or_control: Complete annual penetration testing; produce executive summary and remediation verification letter.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Report date must be within 365 days of assessment date; no open Critical/High vulnerabilities.
exceptions: None.

rule_title: Security Incident Notification Within 72 Hours
rule_text: The vendor shall notify the customer without undue delay and in any event within seventy-two (72) hours of becoming aware of a confirmed personal data breach, security incident, or unauthorized access impacting customer data.
applicability_conditions: Vendor processes European Union personal data or customer contractually designates 72-hour notification threshold.
required_action_or_control: Written notification specifying nature of incident, categories and numbers of data subjects, contact details of DPO, and mitigation steps taken.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Notification window must not exceed 72 hours from detection.
exceptions: Unsuccessful perimeter scans or automated port pings with no breach of system boundaries.

rule_title: Data Deletion and Return Upon Termination
rule_text: Upon termination or expiration of the service agreement, the vendor must delete or return all customer confidential data, backups, and derivative copies within 30 calendar days, and provide a written certificate of destruction signed by an authorized officer.
applicability_conditions: Vendor stores or archives customer data in proprietary storage environments.
required_action_or_control: Perform cryptographic wipe / physical media sanitization according to NIST SP 800-88; issue certificate of destruction within 30 days.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Execution within 30 days of contract termination date.
exceptions: Statutory legal retention obligations required under applicable tax or banking laws.

rule_title: Subcontractor Prior Written Notice and Vetting
rule_text: Vendor shall not engage any sub-processor or subcontractor to process customer confidential data without prior written authorization or at least 30 days prior written notice giving customer the right to object.
applicability_conditions: Vendor uses third-party hosting, infrastructure, or outsourced support services.
required_action_or_control: Maintain published subprocessor list, enforce pass-through compliance agreements, provide 30-day notice prior to onboarding new subprocessors.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Subprocessor registry reviewed and verified semi-annually.
exceptions: Ancillary utility providers (e.g. electric power, internet backbone transit) that do not access decrypted content.

rule_title: ISO/IEC 27001 Certification Validity
rule_text: The vendor must maintain an active, unexpired ISO/IEC 27001 certification covering the scope of services provided to the customer, issued by an accredited certification body.
applicability_conditions: Vendor agreement mandates ISO 27001 certification as a condition of engagement.
required_action_or_control: Submit current certificate demonstrating active status, accredited registrar stamp, and appropriate scope.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Certificate expiry date must be strictly after the assessment date.
exceptions: None. A grace period applies only if an official surveillance audit letter is provided within 60 days.

rule_title: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery (BCDR) Testing
rule_text: Vendor must maintain a tested Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan with Recovery Point Objective (RPO) <= 1 hour and Recovery Time Objective (RTO) <= 4 hours, tested at least once annually.
applicability_conditions: Vendor provides mission-critical operational services.
required_action_or_control: Conduct full failover or simulated disaster recovery test; document actual RTO and RPO achievements against targets.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Test must have been conducted within preceding 12 months.
exceptions: Vendor operating solely as an advisory consultancy with no hosted client software.

rule_title: Non-Disclosure and Confidentiality Survival Obligations
rule_text: Vendor must enter into binding non-disclosure commitments ensuring confidential information remains strictly confidential during the term and surviving for a minimum of five (5) years post-termination, or indefinitely for trade secrets.
applicability_conditions: Vendor receives proprietary source code, business data, or customer non-public materials.
required_action_or_control: Execute bilateral confidentiality agreement; restrict internal distribution to need-to-know employees with written NDAs.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Agreement must be executed prior to data transfer; survival clause >= 5 years.
exceptions: Publicly available information or information independently developed without reference to proprietary data.

rule_title: Quarterly Vulnerability Scanning and Patch Management
rule_text: Vendor must execute automated vulnerability scanning across all systems at least monthly and apply critical security patches within 14 calendar days of release.
applicability_conditions: Vendor manages network devices, web servers, or virtual instances hosting customer data.
required_action_or_control: Run automated authenticated scans; deploy Critical patches <= 14 days, High patches <= 30 days.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Scanning evidence required for each of the last four quarters.
exceptions: Documented compensating controls approved in writing by Vendor CISO where patching causes critical regression.

rule_title: Role-Based Access Control and Principle of Least Privilege
rule_text: Vendor must enforce strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) based on the principle of least privilege, with automated de-provisioning of departing personnel within 24 hours.
applicability_conditions: Vendor manages identity access controls for shared or dedicated customer environments.
required_action_or_control: Formal access provisioning workflow; automated employee offboarding webhook completing revocation in <= 24 hours.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Quarterly user access review records required.
exceptions: None.

rule_title: SOC 2 Type II Annual Independent Examination
rule_text: Vendor must provide an annual SOC 2 Type II audit report issued by an independent AICPA-accredited CPA firm covering Security and Confidentiality criteria over a minimum review period of six (6) consecutive months.
applicability_conditions: Vendor provides cloud-hosted application services or database storage.
required_action_or_control: Deliver unbroken coverage SOC 2 Type II report with unqualified auditor opinion.
evidence_requirements: Bridge / Gap Letter if report ends > 90 days prior
validity_or_deadline_rules: Report period end date must be within 12 months; bridge letter required if > 3 months old.
exceptions: Early stage vendors (under 18 months in operation) may substitute SOC 2 Type I during initial onboarding year.

rule_title: Employee Background Checks and Mandatory Security Training
rule_text: Vendor shall verify criminal background checks for all personnel having access to customer data prior to granting system access, and ensure mandatory annual security awareness training with documented completion rates of at least 95%.
source_name: Enterprise Vendor Risk Management Framework VRM-POL-08
applicability_conditions: Personnel have direct access to customer code repositories, production data, or tenant configurations.
required_action_or_control: Complete 7-year background check; log 100% training completion within 30 days of hire and annually thereafter.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Training metrics assessed annually; completion rate >= 95%.
exceptions: Vendors with zero access to client systems or data.

rule_title: Data Sovereignty and Geographic Storage Restrictions
rule_text: Vendor shall store and process all customer data exclusively within designated geographic regions (e.g., European Economic Area or Continental United States) and shall not transfer data across borders without prior written authorization.
source_name: GDPR Chapter V / EU Standard Contractual Clauses (2021/914)
applicability_conditions: Customer contract contains explicit regional storage boundaries.
required_action_or_control: Configure cloud region pinning to designated data centers; execute transfer impact assessments if transfers occur.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Verified continuously; architecture changes require 60 days advance notice.
exceptions: None unless explicit bilateral standard contractual clauses are signed.

rule_title: Comprehensive Audit Logging and 1-Year Retention
rule_text: Vendor must maintain tamper-evident audit logs of all privileged access, administrative commands, authentication attempts, and data export events, retaining logs in immutable storage for at least 365 calendar days.
source_name: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 10 / ISO 27001 A.8.15
applicability_conditions: Vendor hosts transactional, personal, or administrative interfaces.
required_action_or_control: Stream logs to central SIEM or WORM (Write Once Read Many) storage; configure alerts for log tampering; retain >= 365 days.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Retention rules validated annually during security inspection.
exceptions: Debug-level trace logs in non-production development sandboxes.

rule_title: Mandatory Cyber Liability Insurance Coverage
rule_text: The vendor must maintain comprehensive cyber liability and errors & omissions (E&O) insurance with a minimum limit of $5,000,000 per claim and aggregate, with an unexpired Certificate of Insurance (COI) naming customer as additional insured.
applicability_conditions: Vendor contract value exceeds $250,000 or vendor handles sensitive confidential customer records.
required_action_or_control: Submit ACORD Certificate of Insurance with >= $5M coverage limit, active policy dates, and additional insured endorsement.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Policy must be currently in effect; expiry date must be strictly after current assessment date.
exceptions: Vendors with contract values under $25,000 may provide $1M limits with CISO written waiver.

rule_title: Right to Audit and Inspection Access
rule_text: Vendor shall grant customer and its authorized independent auditors the right to inspect, review, and audit vendor's security controls, facilities, and records relevant to services provided upon thirty (30) days advance notice.
applicability_conditions: Customer procures core operational or IT services from vendor.
required_action_or_control: Agree contractually to on-site or remote audit access once per calendar year or following a security incident.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Contract clause must be active and unamended.
exceptions: Vendor multi-tenant datacenters may satisfy requirement via accredited third-party SOC 2 Type II in lieu of physical inspection.

rule_title: Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) and Code Analysis
rule_text: Vendor must implement a documented Secure SDLC including automated Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), and Software Composition Analysis (SCA) blocking builds with unresolved Critical vulnerabilities.
source_name: NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) SP 800-218
applicability_conditions: Vendor builds or customizes proprietary software applications delivered to or accessed by customer.
required_action_or_control: Integrate SAST/DAST in CI/CD pipeline; remediate open OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities prior to release.
validity_or_deadline_rules: SSDLC reviewed and validated within last 12 months.
exceptions: Off-the-shelf commoditized hardware suppliers.

rule_title: Health Data Safeguards and HIPAA Business Associate Agreement
rule_text: When processing Protected Health Information (PHI), vendor must execute a compliant Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and enforce technical safeguards restricting PHI access to authorized workforce members under 45 CFR §164.312.
source_name: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR Part 160 & Part 164 Subparts A & C
applicability_conditions: Vendor receives, transmits, or stores electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI).
required_action_or_control: Execute bilateral Business Associate Agreement; maintain HIPAA security risk assessment and technical controls.
validity_or_deadline_rules: BAA must be signed prior to PHI transmission and remain in force throughout contract.
exceptions: Vendor processes purely de-identified data meeting HIPAA Expert Determination or Safe Harbor standards under §164.514.

rule_title: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Availability and Downtime Credits
rule_text: Vendor shall guarantee a minimum system availability of 99.9% uptime per calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance, and provide pro-rata service credits for downtime exceeding permissible thresholds.
source_name: Cloud Service Level Agreement Model Schedule B
applicability_conditions: Vendor agreement is for subscription SaaS or cloud hosting.
required_action_or_control: Maintain public or customer-facing status page; publish monthly uptime statistics; calculate service credit vouchers upon request.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Monthly uptime metrics delivered within 10 days of end of calendar month.
exceptions: Excused downtime caused by customer's own network configuration errors or declared force majeure.

rule_title: Contractual Amendment Primacy and Order of Precedence
rule_text: In the event of any conflict or inconsistency between the terms of a Master Services Agreement and a duly executed Contract Amendment, Addendum, or Statement of Work, the terms of the most recent executed Amendment shall prevail to the extent of such conflict.
source_name: Standard Commercial Construction & Precedence Rule CCR-01
applicability_conditions: Multiple contractual instruments exist within the same case relationship.
required_action_or_control: Evaluate subsequent amendments and their execution dates to determine if prior obligations are modified or superseded.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Amendment must be signed by authorized signatories of both parties.
exceptions: Amendments explicitly stating they do not supersede specific core data privacy schedules.

rule_title: Clean Desk and Physical Security Access Controls
rule_text: Vendor facilities housing customer records or developer workstations must enforce badge-controlled physical access, visitor escort procedures, CCTV surveillance at entry points, and clean desk policies.
applicability_conditions: Vendor operates physical office locations where staff handle customer paper or on-premises systems.
required_action_or_control: Maintain electronic badge access logs; retain CCTV footage for at least 90 days; conduct quarterly clean desk sweeps.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Facility audit within last 12 months.
exceptions: 100% remote distributed organizations with zero physical offices, where remote endpoint security controls substitute.

rule_title: Automated Backup Frequency and Offsite Replication
rule_text: Vendor must execute automated daily differential and weekly full encrypted backups of customer database volumes, replicated to a geographically distinct secondary facility at least 250 miles away.
source_name: SOC 2 Type II CC9.1 / ISO 27001 A.8.13
applicability_conditions: Vendor stores persistent customer transaction or profile records.
required_action_or_control: Automated snapshot generation; weekly offsite transfer; quarterly test restoration verified in write-up.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Successful backup restoration drill within last 90 days.
exceptions: Read-only analytics mirrors where original master data resides in customer infrastructure.

rule_title: Notice of Material Change or Control Weakness
rule_text: Vendor must notify customer in writing within ten (10) business days of any material change to its technical security infrastructure, CISO executive departure, change in control/acquisition, or known control exceptions in auditor reports.
applicability_conditions: Designated as Tier-1 or High Risk Vendor in customer vendor registry.
required_action_or_control: Deliver formal written notice to customer vendor management office within 10 business days of material event.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Triggered upon occurrence of qualifying corporate change event.
exceptions: Routine minor software patch releases.

rule_title: AI Model Governance and Customer Data Isolation
rule_text: Vendor utilizing Machine Learning or Generative AI components shall not use customer proprietary data or confidential prompts to train, fine-tune, or improve foundational AI models without express opt-in consent, and must enforce strict tenant data isolation.
source_name: Enterprise Generative AI Vendor Policy GAI-POL-2024
applicability_conditions: Vendor software incorporates LLMs, NLP algorithms, or automated decision-making pipelines.
required_action_or_control: Zero-data-retention (ZDR) API agreements with model providers; strict logical tenant segmentation; documented no-training guarantee.
validity_or_deadline_rules: Annual policy verification and architectural re-attestation.
exceptions: Vendor internal models operating solely on public synthetic benchmark datasets.
